items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Bonk? How did he play in the olden days? When you first heard? [INTERVIEWEE] Well Bonk played on this order. Tip된 stuff with stuff

ctx.x: Well yeah well I mean you if you're talking about get off or something like that. Maybe that what you mean. Yeah did Perez get off? Little not much. I wouldn't say a whole lot. See them fellas sometimes he didn't do like like Buddy Petit and Renny and then when we come up. See them fellas they play straight stuff. Mmhmm. And they started putting extra stuff in this stuff here. Later and Buddy and Renny and them time from what I can see. King Oliver and them kind of fellas. They started putting you know more to…
It was big and little Kato. Two piano players. Dad used to talk to us about that. What about Bonk? How did he play in the olden days? When you first heard?
Well Bonk played on this order. Tip된 stuff with stuff
